person_note: The diagnostic Goodreads passages consistently show a nonparticipating third-person narrator, often with free-indirect access to Nesta or Cassian. First- and second-person forms in the quote set occur in dialogue, direct thought, or paratext and therefore do not contradict the base narration. The sustained authorized preview independently shows third-person narration across both focal characters, while whole-book structural sources confirm that the Nesta/Cassian perspective switches remain third person throughout. Alternating focalizers do not warrant ALTERNATING because the grammatical narrative person does not change. No credible contrary evidence remains.
